_comment: Copy to anonymize-map.json and fill in with the names from your own capture.
anonymize-map.json is gitignored on purpose: it is the reverse lookup, and
committing it would undo the anonymization it performs.
Keep replacements the same shape as the originals. Path depth, hash suffixes and
container naming patterns are what the fixture is for; only the words should change.
_forbidden_comment: Terms that must never survive, checked after every other pass. Nothing here is
rewritten: if one is still present the capture is refused, so put anything you
would rather fail a build than publish in here as well as in "names".
